newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul completes South African sale.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul completes South African sale.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp, an automobile parts manufacturer, said Tuesday it completed the sale of its South African distribution operation to Chariot Holdings Ltd.

The company also said it sold its South African retail operations, inclduing 57 auto parts stores, to Lexshell 16 Investment Holdings (Pty) Limited, a private investment company located in South Africa.
With annual sales of about $120 million in 1996, the combined South African aftermarket operations of Federal-Mogul employed about 1,450 people, the company said.

"We are making great progress on our divestiture plan as announced in February," chief executive officer Dick Snell said in statement. He noted that with these completed sales, Federal-Mogul is more than two-thirds of the way through its restructuring plan.
Federal-Mogul shares closed down 3/8 at 29-1/2 Tuesday.
